rules.interpretation: A higher level never follows from a lower one without evidence at that level. Historical R26 evidence is cited only as historical and never treated as current R27 packaged or hardware proof.

subsystems.name: Core runtime
subsystems.note: A bounded live AgentRuntime/tool/context slice reached a hidden-verifier-passing isolated edit. Completion-gated workflow success and endurance remain unproven.

subsystems.name: ForgeGreen
subsystems.note: Scripted A/B proves duplicate-suppression mechanics, not live-model economic benefit or crossover.

subsystems.name: 8-Bit free-route health
subsystems.note: Catalog drift, canonical health authority, durable ledger, and Free Auto enforcement are deterministic; no provider quota lifecycle was spent.

subsystems.name: 16-Bit paid-route intelligence
subsystems.note: The free-only R27 server quarantines paid execution; paid probes require an explicit policy and spend authorization.

subsystems.name: ForgeVerify
subsystems.note: Windows timeout/process-tree cleanup was revalidated locally; exact current packaged bytes are not yet built.

subsystems.name: Subagents
subsystems.note: The deterministic reviewer-repair case has value; live relevance, precision/recall, and crossover remain unmeasured.

subsystems.name: Planner
subsystems.note: Semantic and legacy protocols canonicalize safely; no live quality or qualification-rate claim exists.

subsystems.name: Context
subsystems.note: One bounded live run observed context invalidation/refresh after a real edit. Live token economics and endurance remain unproven.

subsystems.name: Mission memory
subsystems.note: One-mission stale-summary prompt exclusion is proven; cross-session preference/history behavior is not implemented.

subsystems.name: Browser
subsystems.note: Loopback Chromium runtime and navigation recovery are covered; current packaged browser dogfood is absent.

subsystems.name: Terminal
subsystems.note: PTY process-tree cleanup is locally proven; packaged long-session hygiene is absent.

subsystems.name: Git
subsystems.note: Local dirty-tree, restore, and stale-revision safety are deterministic evidence only.

subsystems.name: GitHub
subsystems.note: PR reconciliation rejects stale/closed state; OAuth/App test-repository flow, push, and CI inspection remain external authorization work.

subsystems.name: Permissions
subsystems.note: R26 has a 44/44 audit; it has not been independently revalidated on current R27 HEAD.

subsystems.name: Recovery
subsystems.note: Worker, mission, synthesis, and process-cleanup recovery are local deterministic evidence.

subsystems.name: Live provider preflight
subsystems.note: OpenRouter catalog/health and a bounded zero-unit route were observed live. Google is suspended, Groq is not plan-attested, and remaining account capacity is unknown.

subsystems.name: Endurance
subsystems.note: 79/79 recovery/growth stress tests are not an unattended multi-hour live soak.

subsystems.name: Single-user performance
subsystems.note: Synthetic million-line and UI projection guards are not portable hardware measurements.

subsystems.name: Packaged desktop
subsystems.note: Fresh production-stamped installer, portable, and archive bytes were built from f197385 and audited, but the identity is dirty because of the protected user diff. Both the new and an R9 control package hit host renderer launch-failed:49, so smoke and hardware proof are blocked without attributing an unproven source cause.

nextRequiredEvidence: A separately completion-gated live workflow whose terminal completed state passes evaluateCompletion; this bounded AgentRuntime harness deliberately does not invoke it.
A representative sustained live run only after the completion-gated slice is successful; current four-turn proof is not endurance.
A clean-source Windows package from the current source commit, exact-byte audit, and successful packaged smoke/dogfood on a host where the sandboxed renderer launches.
Machine-profiled hardware measurements and a second-device comparison when an accessible device exists.
